svg.aria-label: Valx Prose Writer: a note whose sourced words are marked in colour along the provenance ramp, with the byline naming the source and a forbidden word greyed out

text.tspan: The river had not moved in a hundred years, and still everyone spoke of it as

g.text: Sourced words carry the provenance ramp, and the byline follows. Forbidden words grey out without ever touching the file.
